setup.title: Stage the demo vault
setup.desc: Seeds memory facts, six fixture conversations, and the mock provider; opens the chat beside the daily note.

chat-conversation.title: Chat — conversation view
chat-conversation.desc: Markdown answers, provider/model pills, token counts, day separators, and a note open behind the chat. Default dark theme.

chat-code-table.title: Chat — markdown rendering
chat-code-table.desc: Tables, checklists, and a fenced code block rendered inside answers.

chat-history.title: Chat — conversation history
chat-history.desc: The history dropdown over the conversation: every chat is a persisted, searchable markdown note.

chat-model-picker.title: Chat — model picker
chat-model-picker.desc: The model picker across every enabled provider — 53 built-ins plus custom endpoints.

chat-slash-menu.title: Chat — slash commands
chat-slash-menu.desc: Typing "/" opens the 20-command menu: clear, regen, model, agent, leader, export, prompt library…

chat-prompt-library.title: Chat — prompt library
chat-prompt-library.desc: The /prompt picker over the saved prompt library (slash commands execute on send).

chat-mention.title: Chat — @-mention notes
chat-mention.desc: Typing "@" fuzzy-searches the vault and attaches the note as context (pill on the bubble).

chat-mention-pill.title: Chat — attached-note pill
chat-mention-pill.desc: A sent message with an @-attached note: the pill names the file; its content went to the model, not the bubble.

chat-image.title: Chat — image attachments
chat-image.desc: A pasted chart on the user bubble and a vision answer below it.

chat-memory-chip.title: Chat — memory chip
chat-memory-chip.desc: The "memories" badge on a turn that drew on long-term memory; click it to see the facts used.

chat-rag-card.title: Vault retrieval — semantic_search card
chat-rag-card.desc: The RAG tool card with retrieved excerpts (seeded render; the hybrid index itself is a settings toggle).

chat-agent-seeded.title: Agent — tool-call cards
chat-agent-seeded.desc: read_note called inside a chat: the card shows the tool, its arguments, and the result (seeded render).

chat-new-empty.title: Chat — new chat
chat-new-empty.desc: The empty state: provider pill, composer, and the vault behind.

agent-live-read.title: Agent — live tool run
agent-live-read.desc: A real agent turn through the loop: the model calls read_note, the tool executes against the vault, the answer cites it.
agent-live-read.live: mock LLM over local SSE — real tool execution in the vault

agent-live-write.title: Agent — vault write
agent-live-write.desc: create_note executes for real: the note lands in the vault and opens next to the tool card that made it.
agent-live-write.live: mock LLM over local SSE — real note created in the vault

swarm-live.title: Swarm — leader spawns a follower
swarm-live.desc: Leader chat marked with /leader, then one send: the spawn_agent tool starts a follower conversation in its own pane, which reports back into the leader thread.
swarm-live.live: mock LLM over local SSE — real spawn_agent + follower conversation

scheduled-run.title: Scheduled runs — Run now
scheduled-run.desc: The settings card with a daily job, then a real manual fire: the headless run lands as a markdown note and the row shows its status.

diff-rewrite.title: Inline diff rewrite
diff-rewrite.desc: Select text → rewrite-with-AI → review the word-level diff → Accept or Reject. Real run: the mock rewrite replaces the selection.
diff-rewrite.live: mock rewrite through the real selection-action pipeline

autocomplete.title: Inline autocomplete
autocomplete.desc: Ghost text while typing in a note (dedicated model, off by default) — Tab accepts. Real run through the autocomplete controller.
autocomplete.live: mock autocomplete model over local SSE

videos-chat.title: Video — send + streamed reply
videos-chat.desc: Type a prompt, send, watch the reply stream token by token over real SSE. Then /model → picker, @-mention, and cross-conversation search.

videos-agent-terminal-multipane.title: Video — agent tools, terminal shell, multipane
videos-agent-terminal-multipane.desc: Agent tool cards appearing live; a real shell session in the terminal pane; a second chat tab and a popout window.

terminal-stills.title: Terminal pane
terminal-stills.desc: A desktop shell in its own pane (or window) — fresh shell per command, real output. Mobile gets a vault-only shell.

multipane-stills.title: Multi-pane chat
multipane-stills.desc: A second chat as a titled tab and as its own OS window — each pane with its own conversation and model.

arena-stills.title: Multi-model arena
arena-stills.desc: One prompt to two models in parallel: picker, live streaming duel, per-column stop, and promote-to-chat. Mock duel, real arena pipeline.
arena-stills.live: mock duel through the real arena pipeline

video-arena-theme-memory.title: Video — arena duel + live theme switch
video-arena-theme-memory.desc: A full arena take (picker → duel → per-column stop → promote) and the app re-theming live: dark → light → Minimal → Royal Velvet.

video-memory-file.title: Video — memory file
video-memory-file.desc: Memory is a plain markdown note: open AI/Curtis Memory.md, add a fact, save — Curtis recalls it next turn.

settings-groups.title: Settings — every group
settings-groups.desc: The full settings surface: providers, generation, agent, agents, skills, terminal, chat UI, voice, notes, conversations, MCP, GCP, about.

import-flow.title: Chat importer
import-flow.desc: ChatGPT/Claude exports, .curt files, and role-labeled markdown in; every conversation lands as a markdown note under AI/Conversations/. Real import of a role-labeled JSON through the OS file picker.

selection-menu.title: Selection actions
selection-menu.desc: Right-click any selection in a note: explain, summarize, refactor, translate, code review — plus custom actions.

notifications-voice.title: Voice I/O + notifications
notifications-voice.desc: Whisper dictation in, read-aloud with the sentence player; desktop toasts when a reply lands while you are away (in-app notice on mobile).

theme-matrix.title: Theme matrix — 11 themes
theme-matrix.desc: The same conversation rendered full-window in default dark/light and the nine most-installed community themes.

gallery-hero-themes.title: Theme details — composer close-ups
gallery-hero-themes.desc: The composer and message bubbles in three flagships: default dark, Minimal, Royal Velvet (cropped to the chat surface).

mobile-chat.title: Phone — conversation
mobile-chat.desc: The full chat at phone width (390×844): bubbles, pills, composer — the same view, reflowed.

mobile-menus.title: Phone — history, model picker, slash, mention
mobile-menus.desc: Every picker reflows to the sheet style at phone width.

mobile-arena.title: Phone — arena duel
mobile-arena.desc: The arena columns stack and stream at phone width.

mobile-video.title: Phone — video: send + stream
mobile-video.desc: Typing, sending, and a streamed reply at phone width.

mobile-themes.title: Phone — themes
mobile-themes.desc: The chat in default light plus two community themes at phone width.

mobile-settings.title: Phone — settings
mobile-settings.desc: The plugin settings emulated at phone width: provider list and scheduled runs card.

settings-extended.title: Settings — MCP client + Curtis’s own MCP server + GCP
settings-extended.desc: MCP servers you already run can be added as agent tools; Curtis can also SERVE the vault itself over localhost MCP; GCP connects read-only Cloud Storage.
